facts.fact: The Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Act (Act 33 of 2016, Chapter 74:02), published in the Gazette on 4 November 2016, commenced on 1 June 2017 and gives legal recognition to electronic writing, electronic signatures and digital signature certificates (Part III) and defines electronic commerce and distance contracts; the MalawiLII version includes amendments published up to 31 October 2021.
facts.system: Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Act

note: No fact on reach: the document names only the commencement notice (G.N. 25/2017) and states no rules made under the Act or any application of it.
